description: Continuous monitoring of public web pages with change detection. Each URL is baselined on subscription and re-checked hourly, daily or weekly. A change is measured over the page's visible text, so routine churn in tokens, timestamps and ad slots does not read as a change. Every check is recorded, and a webhook fires on each detected change if you give one. Priced per URL per month.

alert_threshold.description: Currently 'any_change': every change to the page's visible text is reported.

name: hsh-monitoring
